title: Director of Quality and Regulation
text:
Northwest Partners is seeking an experienced Director of Quality & Regulatory Compliance to lead a Quality organization within the aerospace and defense industry. This is a senior leadership opportunity for an experienced quality professional with a strong background in aerospace manufacturing, aviation maintenance, and regulatory compliance. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing quality management systems, ensuring compliance with FAA and EASA regulations, and driving continuous improvement across production and repair station operations. Reporting directly to executive leadership, this individual will play a key role in maintaining regulatory approvals, strengthening quality standards, managing audits, and building a culture of accountability, product safety, and operational excellence.

**What You Will Do**

• Lead and oversee the Quality organization and quality management systems across aerospace manufacturing and repair station operations.

• Ensure compliance with FAA regulations, including 14 CFR Parts 21, 43, and 145, as well as applicable EASA Part-145 requirements.

• Oversee FAA Part 21 Production Approval and FAA/EASA Part 145 Repair Station compliance.

• Maintain and continuously improve Quality Manuals, Repair Station Manuals, Quality Control Manuals, and associated procedures.

• Lead regulatory inspections, internal audits, customer audits, and responses to FAA and EASA findings.

• Develop and manage corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes, including root cause analysis and resolution of non-conformances.

• Monitor quality performance metrics, identify risks, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

• Oversee supplier quality management, product conformity, material acceptance, inspection, and quality records.

• Work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, and executive leadership to maintain quality standards.

• Lead, develop, and mentor the Quality team while maintaining independent oversight of quality and regulatory compliance.

• Provide regular updates to executive leadership on compliance, quality performance, risks, and corrective actions.

**What You Will Bring**

• 8–10+ years of progressive experience in aerospace or defense quality assurance, regulatory compliance, manufacturing quality, or aviation maintenance quality.

• 5+ years of leadership experience managing a Quality organization or regulatory compliance function.

• Demonstrated experience within an FAA-regulated aerospace manufacturing environment holding a Part 21 Production Approval.

• Direct experience with FAA Part 145 Repair Station quality systems and regulatory requirements.

• Working knowledge of EASA Part-145 requirements, including compliance monitoring and organizational independence.

• Strong understanding of aerospace quality management systems, including AS9100, AS9110, or equivalent standards.

• Experience managing regulatory audits, responding to findings, and coordinating corrective actions with FAA, EASA, and customers.

• Strong knowledge of root cause analysis, CAPA, supplier quality, and continuous improvement processes.

• Ability to interpret regulatory requirements and translate them into practical procedures and controls.

• Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Aviation, or a related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent education and relevant aerospace industry experience will be considered.

Disclaimer: All candidates will be asked to briefly show a government-issued ID on video during the first interview. This step protects the integrity of the hiring process, given the rise in applicant impersonation and employment fraud.

Comprehensive benefits available to full time employees

Northwest Partners is known for building and managing elite teams in technology across diverse industries. Our mission is to empower every talent and every client to achieve more.
